# 05 Robustness Analysis

Simulates MNAR missingness + noise on the validation set and evaluates the performance retention of DeepTriage-CN, TabNet, and Vitals-only XGBoost. Reproduces Supplementary Figure 1.

import sys
sys.path.append("..")

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import yaml
import joblib
from pathlib import Path

from src.preprocess import load_and_split_data, preprocess_structured, preprocess_text, get_labels
from src.robustness import simulate_degraded_data
from src.structured_encoder import STRUCTURED_FEATURE_NAMES
from evaluation.metrics import compute_all_binary_metrics
from visualization.plot_robustness import plot_robustness_bars

with open("../config.yaml") as f:
    config = yaml.safe_load(f)
rob_cfg = config["robustness"]
output_dir = Path(config["output_paths"]["results_dir"])
fig_dir = Path(config["output_paths"]["figures_dir"])
random_state = config["random_state"]
threshold = config["evaluation"]["optimal_threshold"]

# Load data and models
train_df, val_df = load_and_split_data(
    config["data"]["raw_data_path"],
    training_cutoff_date=config["data"]["training_cutoff_date"],
    validation_start_date=config["data"]["validation_start_date"],
    random_state=random_state,
)
X_train_raw, X_val_raw, scaler = preprocess_structured(train_df, val_df)
train_texts, val_texts = preprocess_text(train_df, val_df)
y_train, y_val = get_labels(train_df, val_df)

deeptriage = joblib.load("../outputs/models/deeptriage_cn.pkl")
vit_xgb = joblib.load("../outputs/models/vitals_only_xgb.pkl")
# TabNet
from src.tabnet_model import TabNetWrapper
tabnet = TabNetWrapper()
tabnet.load("../outputs/models/tabnet")

# Baseline AUROC on clean validation data
text_emb_val = deeptriage.text_encoder.encode(val_texts.tolist())
X_val_std = scaler.transform(X_val_raw)
X_fused = np.hstack([text_emb_val, X_val_std])

baseline_auroc = {}
baseline_auroc["DeepTriage-CN"] = compute_all_binary_metrics(y_val, deeptriage.classifier.predict_proba(X_fused)[:,1], threshold)["auroc"]
baseline_auroc["TabNet"] = compute_all_binary_metrics(y_val, tabnet.predict_proba(X_val_raw)[:,1], threshold)["auroc"]
baseline_auroc["XGBoost (Vitals-only)"] = compute_all_binary_metrics(y_val, vit_xgb.predict_proba(X_val_raw), threshold)["auroc"]
print("Baseline AUROCs:", baseline_auroc)

# Simulate degradation at 30% missing + noise
degraded_sets = simulate_degraded_data(
    X_val_raw,
    STRUCTURED_FEATURE_NAMES,
    missing_proportions=[0.3],
    noise_sigma=rob_cfg["noise_sigma_multiplier"],
    seed=random_state,
)
X_val_degraded = degraded_sets[0.3]
X_val_degraded_std = scaler.transform(X_val_degraded)  # scaler handles NaN

# Evaluate models on degraded data
degraded_auroc = {}
# DeepTriage-CN on degraded structured data (text is clean)
X_fused_degr = np.hstack([text_emb_val, X_val_degraded_std])
degraded_auroc["DeepTriage-CN"] = compute_all_binary_metrics(y_val, deeptriage.classifier.predict_proba(X_fused_degr)[:,1], threshold)["auroc"]

# TabNet
degraded_auroc["TabNet"] = compute_all_binary_metrics(y_val, tabnet.predict_proba(X_val_degraded)[:,1], threshold)["auroc"]

# Vitals-only XGBoost
degraded_auroc["XGBoost (Vitals-only)"] = compute_all_binary_metrics(y_val, vit_xgb.predict_proba(X_val_degraded), threshold)["auroc"]

print("Degraded AUROCs:", degraded_auroc)

# Plot robustness
plot_robustness_bars(baseline_auroc, degraded_auroc,
                     save_path=str(fig_dir / "supp_figure1_robustness.tiff"))

# Save retention data
retention = {k: degraded_auroc[k]/baseline_auroc[k] for k in baseline_auroc}
pd.Series(retention).to_csv(output_dir / "robustness_retention.csv")
print("Robustness analysis complete.")
